description: This file defines a utility class 'dmUtility' with static methods for string manipulation, parsing, and processing related to data models, such as splitting queries, trimming wildcards and properties, and parsing multiset values. It is likely used as a helper in broader data management or configuration parsing contexts within the project.

classes.name: dmUtility
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string and query processing used throughout the project.

methods.name: void splitQuery(char const * query,char * parameter)
methods.description: Extracts the filename or last component after the last '.' or '\' in the query string and copies it into the provided parameter buffer.

methods.name: bool has_suffix(const std::string & str,const std::string & suffix)
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix.

methods.name: bool isWildcard(char const * s)
methods.description: Determines if a given C-string ends with a '.' indicating a wildcard.

methods.name: std::string trimWildcard(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes a trailing '.' from a string if present.

methods.name: std::string trimProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes the property part from a dot-separated property string.

methods.name: std::string trimPropertyName(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Extracts the property name after the last '.' in a string.

methods.name: std::string trimSetProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes brace-enclosed set property or trims property depending on the format.

methods.name: bool parseMultisetValue(std::string const & s,std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>> & nameVals)
methods.description: Parses a string representing multiple key-value pairs within braces into a vector of pairs.

methods.name: void splitString(std::string const & s,char delim,std::vector<std::string> & out)
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on a delimiter character, populating an output vector.
